name: Shield of Light
description: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of light in a cone in front of you. Additional waves will also emanate from allies in a radius around the first target struck, towards that target.

stats: Cannot be used by default
Becomes Usable once for 2 seconds when you Block a Hit
Base radius is 5.5 metres
Additional waves will be created from Allies within a Base
radius of 4 metres of the first Enemy struck
50% of Physical Damage Converted to Lightning Damage
Maximum 4 additional waves
+0.1% to Off Hand Critical Strike Chance per 10 Maximum Energy Shield on Shield
Can't be Evaded

4 to 6 Added Physical Damage per 15 Armour on Shield
